instruction: How many people follow the artist of the currently playing song on Spotify?
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are made (evaluation requires no model changes), so all Spotify actions are read-only lookups asserting knowledge predicates. The world state (which song is playing, its artist, the artist's follower count) is encoded as static init facts with placeholder objects (current-song, current-artist, follower-count-answer) whose concrete values are read at runtime. supervisor.show_profile supplies the login username (supervisor email), show_account_passwords the spotify password; login yields the token; show_current_song reveals the artist id; show_artist (no token needed) reveals the follower count, which is passed as the answer to supervisor.complete_task, the mandatory final action.
